nodes.label: Recheck Snapshot Rule (single listActivitiesDueForRecheck call)
nodes.rationale: The orchestrator must call listActivitiesDueForRecheck only once and freeze the result. Re-calling would overlap or skip items because confirm pushes deadlines out.

nodes.label: Module Depth Concept (Ousterhout-style)
nodes.rationale: Depth = leverage at the interface: large behaviour behind a small interface. Deep modules reduce cognitive cost for callers and concentrate bugs for maintainers (locality).

nodes.label: Seam Concept (from Michael Feathers)
nodes.rationale: A seam is where a module's interface lives — where behaviour can be altered without editing in that place. One adapter = hypothetical seam; two adapters = real seam.

nodes.label: PromoteCandidateUseCase (staging → Activity)
nodes.rationale: Promotes a RawActivityCandidate to a published Activity after bbox validation, deduplication, and freshness computation. DUPLICATE outcome refreshes existing activity freshness.

nodes.label: ConfirmActivityUseCase (refresh + recheckAfter)
nodes.rationale: Called by the recheck MCP tool when an agent confirms an activity still exists. Refreshes lastSeenAt/lastVerifiedAt and recomputes recheckAfter (+90d for PLACE, null for EVENT).

nodes.label: 4 Deterministic MCP Ingestion Tools
nodes.rationale: ingestActivity, listActivitiesDueForRecheck, confirmActivity, archiveActivity. All deterministic writes live in these tools; agents never touch Prisma/DB directly.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Validation (Zod + domain)
nodes.rationale: Layer A (Zod): structural validation at tool boundary → MCP tool error → agent fixes call form. Layer B (domain use cases): business rules → REJECTED outcome + reason → agent fixes data.

nodes.label: Implement-Test-Verify-Commit Increment Cycle
nodes.rationale: Each increment implements the smallest complete piece, tests it, verifies it, and commits before moving to the next slice. Prevents bug compounding and enables granular rollback.

nodes.label: Ingestion Flow (/wandr-ingest orchestrator + wandr-theme-scout)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator dispatches one wandr-theme-scout per ActivityCategory (6 in parallel). Each scout searches web, extracts ExtractedActivityPayload, calls ingestActivity MCP tool.

nodes.label: Recheck Flow (/wandr-recheck orchestrator + wandr-recheck-verifier)
nodes.rationale: Orchestrator snapshots due list once, splits into disjoint ~8-item batches, dispatches one verifier per batch in parallel. Verifiers judge via WebSearch/WebFetch and call confirm or archive.

nodes.label: ActivityCard Facade (CardVariant unified API)
nodes.rationale: Single ActivityCard component with variant prop dispatching to existing card components plus new MediaRowActivityCard. Preferred entry-point; existing imports kept for backward compat.

nodes.rationale: Full-width row card: image left (~38%) or right with content on the opposite side. Extends existing class-card pattern from wandr_design/sport.jsx.
